We evaluated the EGFR mutation status for the treatment of lung cancer according to the results of approved CDx tests to prescribe EGFR-TKIs. However, we usually use only one test in each institution. To the best of our knowledge, there is no report other than the current study that evaluates the influence of replacing the CDx test in clinical practice, but some reports have compared Scorpion and Cobas using identical specimens. 16-20
